research_question: Can a loss-free first-pass unary prediction provide a soft, non-dropping contact-routing prior, and can an alignment-free ordinary-triangle exclusion term make a selected antigen patch compete with distant surface patches without sacrificing partner specificity?

observed_facts_used_to_define_this_follo: full-contact routing showed an early contact and epitope signal but weaker partner specificity
interaction-only routing removed unary shortcuts but did not show the same early contact gain
the original reverse-triangle term did not explicitly push distant patches away
adaptation_disclosure.claim_class: post-hoc exploratory follow-up; it cannot retroactively become a confirmatory experiment

factorized_comparisons.P1_vs_P0: soft first-pass unary contact prior versus no crop, holding the binary contact head and interaction-only interleaved routing fixed
factorized_comparisons.P2_vs_P1: joint direct-contact plus distogram supervision versus binary contact, holding soft cropping and all residue/cross-attention choices fixed
factorized_comparisons.P3_vs_P2: far-patch ordinary-triangle exclusion versus no exclusion, holding the joint pair head, soft crop and all other losses fixed

data.split: frozen antigen-fold v3 train and validation roles only
data.cross_chain_input_geometry: none; each monomer contributes invariant scalar features and intra-chain geometry only
data.bound_distance_policy: authenticated complex distances are supervision only for P2/P3 and are never model inputs

coarse_to_fine_contract.first_pass_loss: none; coarse logits are routing-only and detached
coarse_to_fine_contract.crop_type: soft additive log-prior, never a hard pair mask
coarse_to_fine_contract.reason: an inaccurate first-pass epitope prediction must not irreversibly remove the true interface

far_patch_exclusion_contract.selected_antigen_patch: label-free unary surface seed expanded by monomer-space radius
far_patch_exclusion_contract.distant_antigen_candidates: surface residues outside the selected patch and at least 20 A from its residues

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: maximize the minimum validation cluster-weighted reciprocal interaction-only margin; break ties within 0.0001 by mean per-complex contact AUPRC, then earlier epoch
model_selection.threshold_rule: one global threshold fitted on validation only

training_objective.marginals: per-complex observed-class-balanced epitope and paratope BCE
training_objective.specificity: reciprocal wrong-partner ranking with unlabeled wrong pairs never treated as all-zero contacts
training_objective.wrong_pair_rule: counterfactual ranking and retrieval only; no fabricated binary nonbinder labels

required_epoch_metrics: train objective components and predicted-positive ratio
validation pair contact macro and pooled AUPRC, precision, recall, F1, MCC and predicted-positive ratio
validation epitope and paratope macro AUPRC, precision, recall, F1 and MCC
P@10, P@Lmin/10, P@Lmin/5 and paired Recall@K
reciprocal partner margin, Recall@1 and MRR
pooled Brier, ECE and calibration slope
coarse-prior entropy and retained probability mass
far-patch violation count, loss and recall retention

post_selection_train_audit.timing: only after validation-only checkpoint selection is frozen
post_selection_train_audit.metrics: the same train contact, epitope and paratope metrics as validation, without updating parameters
post_selection_train_audit.purpose: distinguish optimization failure, overfitting and antigen-fold generalization failure

required_interventions: coarse prior set to its neutral floor
promotion_rule: No promotion unless at least 3/5 seeds improve the validation primary metric, paired cluster-bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero, precision and recall do not collapse, and reciprocal partner specificity is not worse than P0.
claim_boundary: Development-only post-hoc exploratory study. No frozen-test, external-generalization, benchmark-improvement or state-of-the-art claim is authorized.
